ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given $AC$ and $BD$ are diameters of $\odot O$, connect $AB$, $BC$, and let point $F$ be a point on $OC$ with $CF=2OF$. As shown in the figure, if $BC=6$ and $\angle BAC=30^\circ$, find the length of $OF$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} It follows from the construction that $AC$ is the diameter of $\odot O$,\\
$\therefore \angle ABC=90^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle BAC=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle C=60^\circ$,\\
$\because OB=OC$,\\
$\therefore \triangle BOC$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
$\therefore OC=BC=6$,\\
$\because CF=2OF$,\\
$\therefore OF=\frac{1}{3}OC=2$;\\
Therefore, the length of $OF$ is $\boxed{2}$.
